label: A tank monitoring screen: the tank with its level bar and the high-level alarm line, a pressure gauge with its high alarm and red relief limit, and a temperature reading from the bilge well in the tank connection space.

marks.alarm: HIGH LEVEL SHUT-OFF · bunkering valve closed

steps.title: 1 · Every essential value can be read locally and remotely - bunkering included
2 · Level: a high-level alarm, and a separate sensor that closes the bunkering valve so the tank never fills full
3 · Pressure: a gauge on the tank, repeated on the bridge, marked with the highest and lowest allowed pressure; an alarm before the relief valves lift
4 · Temperature: a sensor in the tank connection space bilge well - cold means liquid has leaked, and the safety system acts
